name: OpenMuse Substrate Engine
description: Headless substrate engine providing persistent Playwright browser sessions, durable SQL-leased task execution, and execution sandbox.

enabled.description: Whether the OpenMuse headless substrate engine is enabled.

browserProfileDir.description: Directory for persistent browser profiles and cookies (defaults to ~/.friday/openmuse/browser_profiles).

taskDbPath.description: Path to SQLite task database (defaults to ~/.friday/openmuse/tasks.db).
